references.text: The same context of rejoicing before the Lord's presence and eating together as part of worship
Reiteration of the command to rejoice before the Lord with the whole household and the Levite
The Levite living in the towns must be included because he has no inheritance or property
The same command to rejoice before the Lord with sons, daughters, servants, and the Levite at the festival
Command to be glad during the Feast of Tabernacles with the whole household, including the Levite
Explanation of why the Levite has no inheritance—the Lord is their inheritance
The tribe of Levi has no inheritance because the Lord himself is their inheritance
Levitical priests have no inheritance in Israel; the Lord is their inheritance
Confirmation that the tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the offerings were their portion
Nehemiah's concern for the Levites who had to leave their service due to lack of support
